**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Invalidate the legacy one-page cache on upgrade**

For an upgraded iOS or Android install that already has the former 25-account SQLite cache, this new call is skipped because the enclosing guard still requires `forceSync` or an empty cache, while `DashboardScreen._loadAccounts` calls `fetchAccounts` with the default `forceSync: false` (`mobile/lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart:111`). A normal post-upgrade launch therefore continues to show "Unknown account" for accounts beyond the cached first page until a separate full-sync or clear-data path happens; version/invalidate the old cache or force one complete account refresh after upgrade.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

** Minor** · **Performance & Scalability** · **Quick win** **Fail fast when `total_pages` exceeds `maxPages`.** When page 1 reports more than `maxPages`, `getAllAccounts` can make up to 99 additional sequential requests before returning the aggregate failure. These requests can succeed, but the loaded accounts are discarded. Each request can also wait up to 30 seconds. Check the bound immediately after updating `totalPages`. Update `stops instead of following an absurd total_pages` to pass `log: requests` and assert that exactly one request was made.
♻️ Proposed change
```diff --- "a/mobile/lib/services/accounts_service.dart" +++ "b/mobile/lib/services/accounts_service.dart" @@ -40,16 +40,15 @@ accounts.addAll((result['accounts'] as List).cast()); pagination = result['pagination'] as Map?; totalPages = (pagination?['total_pages'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 1; + if (totalPages > maxPages) { + return { + 'success': false, + 'error': 'Too many account pages to load ($totalPages)', + }; + } page++; } - - if (totalPages > maxPages) { - return { - 'success': false, - 'error': 'Too many account pages to load ($totalPages)', - }; - } return { 'success': true, ```
Committable suggestion
> **IMPORTANT** > Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements. ```suggestion totalPages = (pagination?['total_pages'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 1; if (totalPages > maxPages) { return { 'success': false, 'error': 'Too many account pages to load ($totalPages)', }; } page++; } ```

jjmata asked to address open review comments. Both open threads are fixed in bb097e4:

- CodeRabbit (`accounts_service.dart`, fail fast): `getAllAccounts` now returns the "Too many account pages" failure right after the first page that reports `total_pages > maxPages`, so no further requests are made. The test asserts a single request.
- Codex (`accounts_provider.dart`, legacy cache): `fetchAccounts` now also refetches when the cached list has exactly 25 accounts (`AccountsService.legacyPageSize`), which is what older versions saved as a truncated first page. Families with exactly 25 accounts just refetch on launch.

This change was made with Claude Code.
